en.bodyMarkdown:
### Highlights
- Four crash fixes: model-failure exit-code classifier triggers a clear re-download prompt, heartbeat startup timeout prevents indefinite hangs, recording idempotency guard blocks duplicate sessions on rapid hotkey presses, and a hotkey TypeError fallback prevents crashes on unsupported key tokens
- Groq STT removed — existing Groq users automatically fall back to On-Device STT on first launch; no data is lost
- Deepgram Nova-2 is now a fully supported, production-ready cloud STT alternative (free tier: 45 h/month)
- Settings shows inline signup links for Deepgram and OpenAI so new users never have to leave the app to get started

### Improvements
- Sentry fingerprints now include recording phase and STT status for better issue grouping
- Safety-guard activations (OOM, CPU fallback, idempotency) are captured as Sentry breadcrumbs for easier support triage
- Smart-Mode dead code fully removed — smaller bundle, cleaner settings diff
- README and website feature list updated to accurately reflect the shipped feature set (Post-Processing, LLM auto-tagging, and Groq references removed)
- AppSettings split into focused section classes; STT subsystem split into independent modules; recording orchestrator decomposed into SafetyGuard, OomRecoveryHandler, and RecordingStateMachine; floating UI shares a single platform host

en.bodyMarkdown:
### Highlights
- Complete rewrite as a native Flutter app — truly cross-platform (Windows and macOS)
- All transcript history stored locally in SQLite — no shared config files, no data loss
- New slim recording pill overlay with live waveform and progress indicator
- Always-on-top floating button for instant voice input from any app, with expanded context menu (open, record, history, settings, quit)
- Premium UI with warm gradients, frosted glass effects, and micro-animations
- macOS app ships as a native ARM64 DMG with every release
- History transcript editor now fully supports all text editing keys — Enter, Backspace, Delete, and cursor navigation work correctly when focused

### Improvements
- All Go backend code removed — zero external dependencies
- Riverpod state management for reactive, testable architecture
- 469+ automated tests with over 90 percent feature coverage
- macOS menu bar icon resolves correctly across all bundle layouts

- Settings reorganized with clearer sections and everyday language throughout
- Faster model downloads with resume support for interrupted connections
- Fixed a race condition when switching pages quickly
